7.8.5.4 LINTP_E_SWAPPED_CONSECUTIVE_FRAMES_RECEIVED
[SWS_LinIf_00884] ⌈ Error Name: LINTP_E_SWAPPED_CONSECUTIVE_FRAMES_RECEIVED Short Description: A swapped Consecutive Frame is received Long Description: LinIf (LinTp part) shall report a LINTP_E_SWAPPED_CONSECUTIVE_FRAMES_RECEIVED Extended Production Error to DEM when swapped Consecutive Frames are received. Fail Swapped Consecutive Frames are received Detection Criteria: Pass LinTp_Init() function call Secondary Parameters: The condition under which the FAIL and/or PASS detection is active: None Time Required: Not applicable Monitor Frequency: on event
⌋()
